description: Poll patient CSV files from SFTP, stage locally, parse CSV to Dialect A XML, map to SQLXML, and insert into SQL Server dbo.CsvPatients.

cases.title: Inject sample CSV via Demo tab reaches SQL
cases.description: Drop samples/patients.csv to SFTP upload; EIP stages, parses, and inserts rows into CsvSftpDemo.dbo.CsvPatients.
steps: Open Demo tab and inject patients.csv (or upload to SFTP upload/)
Wait for Route 1 poll (~10s) then Route 2 (~5s)
Confirm at least one new row in dbo.CsvPatients
cases.expect: Rows present for patientId values from samples/patients.csv

cases.title: Both routes visible in Routes tab
cases.description: Web UI Routes tab shows 1 - SFTP Poll And Stage and 2 - CSV To SQL with V2 diagrams.
steps: Select each route and confirm Listener → Processor → Transport topology
cases.expect: Both route diagrams render without requiring EIP for docs mode
